```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

**Status: EXPLORATORY.** Descriptive plots of the raw pots; no tests.

**Why this file.** The inoculation reversal (Figure 1, `11_Figure1_Reversal`) lives in the severe
drought (40% FC) cell. This file drops the cell means and shows all 20 severe-drought pots on one
panel, so each pot's productivity can be read against its allocation to berries.

**Encoding.** x = wheat berry allocation (berry mass / wheat NPP, `berry_alloc`). y = wheat NPP.
Colour and fill = inoculation, as in `fig_style.R` (inoculated #CC5500 filled, sterile #6B90CC open).
Shape = stand type (circle = monoculture, triangle = wheat/ fava intercrop).

**Two y axes, because of density.** Monoculture pots hold 12 wheat plants and intercrop pots hold 6,
so NPP *per pot* compares stand types at unequal density (as flagged in Figure 1). The first figure
uses per pot (matches `Fig1_NPP_perPot`); the second uses per plant (`W_NPP_pp`), which puts the two
stand types on the same footing.

```{r libs}
library(tidyverse)
source("../fig_style.R")

sev <- readRDS("../wheat_audited.rds") %>% filter(Water == "Severe") %>%
  mutate(Poly = poly_factor(Poly),
         grp = interaction(Poly, Inoc, sep = "_", lex.order = TRUE),
         berry_pct = berry_alloc * 100,
         npp_pot = W_NPP, npp_plant = W_NPP_pp)
stopifnot(nrow(sev) == 20, all(table(sev$Poly, sev$Inoc) == 5),
          isTRUE(all.equal(sev$npp_pot, sev$npp_plant * sev$Num_wheat_pot, tolerance = 1e-3)))
```

```{r scales}
grp_lab   <- c(Mono_Inoc = "Monoculture, inoculated", Mono_Strl = "Monoculture, sterile",
               Inter_Inoc = "Intercrop, inoculated",  Inter_Strl = "Intercrop, sterile")
grp_col   <- c(Mono_Inoc = pal_inoc[["Inoc"]], Mono_Strl = pal_inoc[["Strl"]],
               Inter_Inoc = pal_inoc[["Inoc"]], Inter_Strl = pal_inoc[["Strl"]])
grp_fill  <- c(Mono_Inoc = pal_inoc[["Inoc"]], Mono_Strl = "white",
               Inter_Inoc = pal_inoc[["Inoc"]], Inter_Strl = "white")
grp_shape <- c(Mono_Inoc = 21, Mono_Strl = 21, Inter_Inoc = 24, Inter_Strl = 24)

pot_scatter <- function(y, ylab) {
  ggplot(sev, aes(berry_pct, {{ y }}, colour = grp, fill = grp, shape = grp)) +
    geom_point(size = 3.2, stroke = 1.1) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = grp_col, labels = grp_lab, name = NULL) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = grp_fill, labels = grp_lab, name = NULL) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = grp_shape, labels = grp_lab, name = NULL) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 2), fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2), shape = guide_legend(nrow = 2)) +
    labs(x = "Wheat berry allocation (% of wheat NPP)", y = ylab) +
    theme_fig() +
    theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3))
}
```

# Cell means (severe drought, n = 5 per group)

```{r means}
sev %>% group_by(Poly, Inoc) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), `berry alloc (%)` = mean(berry_pct), `min` = min(berry_pct), `max` = max(berry_pct),
            `NPP per pot (g)` = mean(npp_pot), `NPP per plant (g)` = mean(npp_plant), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2))) %>%
  knitr::kable()
```

# Figure: NPP per pot against berry allocation

```{r fig-pot, fig.width = 6.5, fig.height = 5.5}
fig_pot <- pot_scatter(npp_pot, "Wheat NPP per pot (g)")
fig_pot
dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)
ggsave("figures/Fig22_Severe_NPPpot_vs_Berry.pdf", fig_pot, width = 6.5, height = 5.5)
ggsave("figures/Fig22_Severe_NPPpot_vs_Berry.png", fig_pot, width = 6.5, height = 5.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

# Figure: NPP per plant against berry allocation

```{r fig-plant, fig.width = 6.5, fig.height = 5.5}
fig_plant <- pot_scatter(npp_plant, "Wheat NPP per plant (g)")
fig_plant
ggsave("figures/Fig22_Severe_NPPplant_vs_Berry.pdf", fig_plant, width = 6.5, height = 5.5)
ggsave("figures/Fig22_Severe_NPPplant_vs_Berry.png", fig_plant, width = 6.5, height = 5.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```
